description: server.rs uses a Semaphore to cap total concurrent connections but has no per-source-IP rate limiting. A remote host can open MAX_CONNECTIONS simultaneous connections or rapidly cycle connections to exhaust the semaphore and deny service to other senders. RFC 5321 §4.5.3.2 recommends rate controls. Without per-IP rate limiting, a single malicious peer can prevent all other inbound delivery. Fix: add a per-IP token bucket or sliding-window counter before accepting the connection.
title: smtp: no inbound connection rate limiting on port 25
